summary: Frontend testing complete for 4 homepage improvements. All features working correctly: sticky contribution bar, immersive main journey layout, plan trip intro text, and 4-line inspirational quote.
passed_tests: Homepage loads without errors
Sticky contribution bar appears at bottom when scrolling past 600px
Sticky bar shows journey name ('China') and poetic name ('Onde os Dragões Dançam')
Sticky bar shows progress bar (2.5%)
Sticky bar shows 'Contribuir para este Sonho' button with heart icon
Sticky bar disappears when scrolling back to top (below 600px)
Sticky bar hidden when CheckoutModal is open (!showCheckout condition)
Clicking 'Contribuir para este Sonho' on sticky bar opens CheckoutModal
CheckoutModal shows amount buttons (€10, €20, €50, €100, €200, €500, €1000)
CheckoutModal shows step progress (1. Valor, 2. Pagamento, 3. Instruções)
CheckoutModal can be closed with Escape key or close button
Clicking 'Contribuir para este Sonho' on main journey section opens CheckoutModal
Main journey section has immersive full-background image layout
Main journey section has gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80)
Main journey text overlay shows: 'Viagem Principal' badge, 'China' title, poetic name, emotional message, progress bar
Plan trip section shows intro text: 'Descobre quanto pode custar a tua viagem e encontra as melhores opções de voos, alojamento e experiências.'
Plan trip section shows search description: 'Ferramentas úteis para planear a viagem dos teus sonhos'
Final quote section shows 4 lines: quote1 (grey), quote2 (peach), quote3 (grey), quote4 (peach)
Quote 1: 'Todos os sonhos começam com um primeiro passo.'
Quote 2 (peach): 'Ajuda alguém a viajar hoje.'
Quote 3: 'E amanhã pode ser a tua vez.'
Quote 4 (peach): 'Juntos, transformamos sonhos em destinos.'
critical_code_review_comments: Sticky bar correctly uses framer-motion AnimatePresence for smooth appear/disappear animation
Sticky bar visibility correctly conditioned on !showCheckout to hide when modal is open
Main journey section properly implements immersive layout with absolute positioned image and gradient overlay
Plan trip intro uses t('home.plan_trip_intro') key correctly defined in LanguageContext
Quote section properly renders 4 lines with alternating grey/peach (#FFBE98) colors using t() function
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage improvements tested and working: 1) Sticky bar at bottom appears/disappears on scroll (600px threshold), 2) Immersive main journey with full-background image, 3) Plan trip intro text present, 4) Quote section has 4 lines. Main journey is 'China' at 2.5% funded. CheckoutModal opens correctly from both sticky bar and main section contribute buttons.
